scope: Trace the 1960 teachers-organization legislative track into the State Council record and refine the teachers-union event/actor graph without collapsing distinct bills.

new_primary_archive_anchor.title: 국무회의 안건 목록집 I - 1960년도
new_primary_archive_anchor.significance: This directly confirms that the Teachers' Organization Bill was not merely an Education Ministry draft mentioned in later synthesis: it reached the 37th State Council agenda on 1960-10-08, alongside a separate Education Public Officials Act amendment. The actual 15-page bill text and deliberation result remain to be retrieved from BA0084253.

event_updates.finding: KDemo synthesis says the Education Ministry prepared the bill on 1960-09-26; National Archives State Council agenda independently confirms a 15-page 교직단체법(안), proposed by the Education Ministry, on the 37th State Council agenda dated 1960-10-08, management no. BA0084253.

event_updates.open_question: Was item 288 approved, modified, deferred, returned, or otherwise disposed of at the 37th State Council meeting? Retrieve minutes/agenda file text.
Determine whether item 287 was legally or politically coupled to the Teachers' Organization Bill and whether it altered the status/discipline/association rights of teachers.

adversarial_checks: Do not infer that the State Council approved the Teachers' Organization Bill merely because it appears on the agenda.
Do not attribute the Education Ministry proposal personally to Oh Cheon-seok until the proposal file/minutes establish authorization or authorship.
Do not attribute the State Council's consideration personally to Chang Myon without minutes or instruction records.
Keep Kwak Tae-jin et al.'s Labor Union Act amendment and the Education Ministry Teachers' Organization Bill as distinct legislative tracks.
Test whether the simultaneously tabled Education Public Officials Act amendment was a companion measure or an unrelated technical amendment.
The KDemo statement that the Teachers' Organization Bill was eventually abandoned on 1961-02-12 still requires an official disposal record.
The KDemo characterization of the government's strategy as 'reformist co-optation' is historiographical interpretation, not a contemporaneous state document.
The union's characterization of the bills as illegalization or suppression remains an actor claim unless supported by bill text and legal effect.
The 1960-08-25 Daegu High Court result reported in later sources must be checked against the decision text before treating 'union legality' as the precise holding.
The 82-unit figure in KDemo's own July 17 summary strengthens the need to preserve the earlier 82/83 organizational-count conflict rather than silently choosing one.
priority_leads: 국가기록원 관리번호 BA0084253의 제37회 국무회의 상정안건철에서 15쪽짜리 교직단체법(안) 원문을 확보하여 목적·가입대상·조직형태·쟁의권·노조와의 관계 조문을 추출한다.
동일 BA0084253에서 교육공무원법 중 개정 법률(안) 3쪽 원문을 확보하여 교직단체법과 companion bill인지 판별한다.

대구고법 1960-08-25 행정처분 집행정지 결정문을 확보해 판단대상과 교원노조 합법성 언급이 ratio인지 부수적 판단인지 구분한다.

1960-06-22 보사부→법무부 교원노조 적법성 질의 공문 원문과 문서번호를 확보한다.
